elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The clause states a USD 2,000,000 primary limit but does not specify a per-occurrence limit.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: The clause states a USD 2,000,000 primary limit but does not specify an aggregate limit.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) coverage is only USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative language provides only USD 2,000,000 of cyber and privacy coverage. It does not demonstrably establish that M&I does not process Customer Data, so the conditional requirement cannot be treated as met.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: M&I must maintain Workers' Compensation Insurance as mandated by the state in which the Services are performed.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: M&I must deliver original Certificates of Insurance annually at Customer's request.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) coverage has a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance has a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.
